distractors.text_hint: the broken coffee machine in the canteen

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Morning, everyone. Can you hear me all right? Teams has picked a different microphone again.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yeah, just about.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Bit faint, Sarah. Sounds like you're at the other end of the room.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Hang on... there. Headset rather than the laptop.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Yeah, that's better.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: While we're getting settled, the broken coffee machine in the canteen has really improved my Wednesday.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: You might have to drink water, Callum. Terrible situation.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: I've got tea. It's not the same relationship.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Brought mine from home. Rookie mistake, relying on that thing.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: All right, no need to look quite so pleased with yourself, Jamie.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Between that and the traffic on the ring road, it's a cheerful start. I barely moved for ages.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Same. Everyone trying the other lane, then trying to get back in.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yeah, gaining about half a car length. Anyway, we're here.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Have we got everyone who's coming?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Everyone for today, yeah. Haley's not in.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Haley asked me to pass on where he's got to with chasing the purchase order. He's done the prep; just the write-up left.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Right, cheers for passing that on.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Tommo, yours?

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Yeah, the near-miss write-up for the pop valve is finished. All signed off.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Good stuff.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: And my contractor booking for the desiccant unit is sorted. They've actually been in as well—no issues found.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Oh, that's reassuring.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yeah, nice to have a straightforward one.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Sarah, what about the timing for sending the shift handover report round?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: That's moved. I'll send the shift handover report round by the end of the week now.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Right, thanks.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay, today's new bits. Not a massive list.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Go on.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Tommo, can you grease and check the bearings on the Main Outfeed Conveyor by the 28th? It matters but it's not urgent.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Um, I can't take that on, sorry. I haven't got the capacity.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Fair enough. Olumide Adeyemi, can you take that instead?

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: The bearings on the Main Outfeed Conveyor, grease and check, yeah?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yeah, that's it. By the 28th, and as I say, it matters but it's not urgent.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll take it. I'll grease and check the bearings.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Okay, got that.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Sorry, took me a second. Someone started speaking next to me.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Thought you were pretending the connection had gone.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: No, no. My frozen face is usually much more convincing.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right. Callum, you were coming in there?

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah, so, the near miss at the new line needs writing up. I'll write that up.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Yeah, that's worth having properly written down.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks, Callum. That's yours, then.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yep, I'll do the write-up.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Sorry, did I talk over someone then? I got a sort of double voice.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: You're all right. We heard Callum.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Ah, okay. It's doing that thing where everyone goes quiet, then all the sound arrives at once.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Yes. Usually makes it sound like we're having a much bigger argument than we are.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Anything else we actually need to agree this morning?

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Nothing else from me.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: No, I'm all right.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Nothing from stores.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: No more here.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: I'm good, thanks.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, we'll leave it there. Thanks, everyone.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Cheers. Back to my disappointing tea.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Enjoy that. Bye, all.
